segments.ja301:1.1: Vivarathimāsaṃ [vivaratha imāsaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] dvāraṃ, nagaraṃ pavisantu [pavisituṃ mayā;(ka.)] aruṇarājassa;
segments.ja301:1.3: Sīhena susiṭṭhena, surakkhitaṃ [susatthena, surakkhitaṃ (sī. pī.), susiṭṭhena (ka.)] nandisenena.
segments.ja301:2.1: Jayo kaliṅgānamasayhasāhinaṃ, parājayo anayo [ajayo (syā.), anvito (ka.)] assakānaṃ;
segments.ja301:2.3: Icceva te bhāsitaṃ brahmacāri, na ujjubhūtā vitathaṃ bhaṇanti.
segments.ja301:3.1: Devā musāvādamupātivattā, saccaṃ dhanaṃ paramaṃ tesu [tathaṃ pemakaraṃ nu (ka.), tathaṃ paramaṃ karaṃ nu (syā.)] sakka;
segments.ja301:3.3: Taṃ te musā bhāsitaṃ devarāja, kiṃ vā paṭicca maghavā mahinda.
segments.ja301:4.1: Nanu te sutaṃ brāhmaṇa bhaññamāne, devā na issanti purisaparakkamassa;
segments.ja301:4.3: Damo samādhi manaso abhejjo [adejjo (sī. pī.), abhijjo (ka.)], abyaggatā nikkamanañca [nikkhamanañca (sī.)] kāle;
segments.ja301:4.5: Daḷhañca viriyaṃ purisaparakkamo ca, teneva āsi vijayo assakānanti.
